[[Tengu Assassin]]s are [[Angchu]] [[Tengu]] that can be found in the Angchu outposts [[Aerie]] and [[The Roost]].

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Xaquang Skyway}}
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Kinya Province}}

==Dialogue==
{{section-stub}}
'''In Kinya Province (non-Factions characters):'''
:''"The people of Shing Jea have earned our trust through years of respect and friendship, to say nothing of the efforts of [[Master Togo]], bringer of peace. The same cannot be said for you. We know not what you might bring, but from your appearance I would guess it is not peace."''

==Quotes==
{{section-stub}}
'''In Kinya Province (Factions characters):'''
:''"Not many will speak of it, but Master Togo was instrumental in bringing about the end of the wars."''
:''"One of our own teaches at the Monastery. I doubt he is well accepted among his peers."''
:''"Since the wars have come to an end we have lived here in relative peace."''
:''"Those who respect the land and all its creatures are friend to the Angchu Tengu."''
:''"Welcome to the Aerie."''


==Notes==
*Though allies, they will not attack aggressive foes.
